changes.comment: `<spa-manager default-title>`: the title a route without `document-title` falls back to, recorded from the page's `<title>` when a route first retitles the page (replaces the internal `_defaultTitle`)

Prerendered pages: the first update runs without a View Transition or `transition-delay`, a reload restores its saved scroll position as the manager mounts, and a page served for a URL another route matches drops its content and renders the matching route
`render-timeout` now reveals a route still waiting for its `ready-on` event instead of leaving it hidden
A `same-route="refresh"` route no longer tears down on its first registration match
